name: io.github.kieksme/enhancv-mcp
title: Enhancv
description: Manage Enhancv resumes: list, read, create, upload, export to PDF, duplicate and delete.

environmentVariables.name: ENHANCV_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Enhancv API key (starts with enh_live_). Create it under Account Settings > Profile > API Keys (Business Plus plan).

environmentVariables.name: ENHANCV_FILES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory below which resume upload and PDF export may read and write files. File access is off when unset.
